items.name: body slider x
items.description:
🧬 BodySlider X: Flux-Grade Anatomy & Texture Injector

BodySlider X is not a conventional LoRA. It is a visual fidelity injection tool designed to transplant the aesthetics, lighting, and anatomical correction of the Flux model directly into your workflow, without compromising prompt flexibility.

📋 Technical Specifications (Engineering Specs)

  • Model Name: BodySlider X

  • Version: v5 (Gold Master)

  • Training Base: 1,000+ Synthetic Images (Flux Pro/Dev)

  • Network Architecture:

    • Network Rank (Dim): 128 (High texture storage capacity)

    • Network Alpha: 64 (0.5 damping factor for stability)

  • Encoder: UNet Only (Text Encoder Learning Rate = 0). The model does not learn semantic concepts, only visual ones.

  • Training Resolution: 640x960 (Aspect Ratio Bucketing enabled)

🚀 Key Features

✅ Zero Concept Bleeding (TE-0):

Since the Text Encoder was zeroed out, the LoRA is agnostic. It works on any ethnicity (Asian, Black, Caucasian), hair color, or setting. It does not attempt to transform your character into the person from the dataset.

✅ "8K" Micro-Texture:

Thanks to Rank 128, the model has enough information density to render 8K-level details. Freckles, pores, and skin imperfections are generated as distinct, sharp geometry, supporting extreme upscales without blurring.

✅ Material Physics:

Corrects how tight clothing interacts with the body (button tension, denim folds, fabric elasticity), eliminating the "painted-on clothes" look.

✅ Global Illumination:

Simulates the Subsurface Scattering (light penetrating the skin) typical of Flux, removing the plastic appearance of older models.

To activate the model you need to insert the token "mdlnbfsldrn" and the class "woman"

items.name: Body Type Slider - Pony / Illustrious
items.description:
New and custom content here: https://aicollective.ghost.io/

Slider for controlling body type, seems to work well. More extreme situations might be hard, but anything that is realistic should work fine.

This slider also have minimal effect on generation unless you use high or low weights, but I found -2 to 2 to be sufficient for most use cases. It struggles a lot more with big bodies than skinny ones, and will usually start to distort after around -2. Adding prompts like ¨fat¨ works as a work around. You can also add "skinny" to negative prompt

Also works with SDXL but needs different weights.

It also might work better with other Checkpoints, but I have done limited testing.

As always any feedback and posted images are appreciated :)

items.name: Body weight slider. (Skinny ===> Fat slider)
items.description:
Recommended negative prompt: lowres, bad quality, worst quality, bad anatomy, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, sketch

I also recommend using this upscaler: https://openmodeldb.info/models/2x-AnimeSharpV4

Usable weight: from -3 to 3+, depending on the checkpoint and additional LORA used

No trigger word is needed

modelVersions.name: Krea2
modelVersions.description: Works in wide range from -7 to 7, you can try higher weights depending on checkpoint and additional lora used

items.name: Body Weight Slider
items.description:
This is a slider LoRA that can be used to modify the body weight of a character.

This also works well when used along character LoRAs.

There is a slight color shift with v1.0 where slender characters tend to be pale and overweight characters tend to be tanned, I'll fix this for the next version.

There is no particular prompting needed.
woman walking in the streets would work for example.

The trained weights are -2.0 to 2.0, but -1.5 to 1.5 provides more realism (but I don't judge).

Please let me know if you have slider LoRAs requests, I love making them.

modelVersions.name: v1.5
modelVersions.description:
• The color shift should now be mostly gone.

  • Removed the "bony" figure at low weight.

items.name: Body Wetness Slider
items.description:
A simple concept LoRA slider designed to make image generation easier and more controllable.

Recommended weight range:

  • ILLUSTRIOUS: 0 to 1.1

  • SDXL 1.0: 0 to 1

  • PONY: 0 to 1.1

Going beyond this range may cause visual artifacts or unstable results.

How to use:

Simply increase the LoRA weight until you achieve the desired result.

Trigger words: None required.
